title: Camper unlawfully driven away in Pleasanton Twp., per police log - NewsBreak
text:
By Arielle Breen ,
12 hours ago The Manistee County Sheriff's Office is located at 1525 East Parkdale Ave., in Manistee. (News Advocate/File Photo) The Manistee County Sheriff’s Office responded to the following complaints from Aug. 21-23.
All calls may not be reported and it is compiled by assistant editor Arielle Breen .
Aug. 21 • Larceny from a building was reported at 9:40 a.m. in Manistee Township.
• Malicious destruction of property was reported at 10:23 a.m. in Maple Grove Township.
• A dog was running loose at 10:32 a.m. in Maple Grove Township.
• Deputies helped a person at 12:19 p.m. in Onekama Township.
• Deputies conducted a liquor inspection at 2:21 p.m. in Dickson Township.
• A suspicious situation was reported at 4:11 p.m. in Filer Township.
• A civil property dispute was reported at 7:48 p.m. in Norman Township.
Aug. 22 • Deputies were on civil standby at 8:57 a.m. in Norman Township.
• A civil property dispute was reported at 10:17 a.m. in Manistee Township.
• Unlawful entry was reported at 11:20 a.m. in Dickson Township.
• Unlawful entry was reported at 1 p.m. in the village of Onekama.
• Malicious destruction of property was reported at 1:11 p.m. in Stronach Township.
• A dog was running loose at 3:04 p.m. in Maple Grove Township.
• A person unlawfully drove away a camper at 9:57 p.m. in Pleasanton Township.
Aug. 23 • Domestic assault was reported at 3:29 a.m. in the village of Kaleva.
• Deputies conducted a well-being check in Onekma Township. The time was not provided.
• A verbal domestic incident was reported in Norman Township. The time was not provided.
• A personal injury crash was reported at 2:30 p.m. in Stronach Township.
• A suspicious situation was reported at 6:31 p.m. in Manistee Township.
summary: (News Advocate/File Photo) The Manistee County Sheriff’s Office responded to the following complaints from Aug. 21-23. All calls may not be reported and it is compiled by assistant editor Arielle Breen . • Malicious destruction of property was reported at 10:23 a.m. in Maple Grove Township. • Deputies conducted a liquor inspection at 2:21 p.m. in Dickson Township. • Deputies conducted a well-being check in Onekma Township.
